title: Planar mirror water with a ≥1024 render target
note: A planar mirror needs a render target of 1024 or more; 512 and below is what reads as blocky and stepped.
intent: Water only reads as water when a real mirrored image of the scene sits in it. A second PerspectiveCamera reflected through the water plane renders into a WebGLRenderTarget of at least 1024×1024 every frame (512 or lower is what the judge calls "blocky / stepped rectangles", 256 never passes, and rendering every N frames is a rejection too), with a clip plane at the waterline so nothing below the surface leaks into the mirror. The water shader samples that target in projected screen space, perturbs the UV horizontally only by ≤ 0.02 UV units (2–3 sine octaves, amplitude ≤ 0.01, wavelength ≤ 0.3 units — larger amplitude turns a mirror into a vertical smear), keeps the vertical stretch of the mirrored image at 1.0–1.3×, and mixes it with the dark base by a fresnel term capped near 0.3 so the base albedo still wins at steep angles. Blur, if any, is one 3-tap vertical pass — a box blur produces the stepped rectangles. Screen-space, cubemap, scrolling-UV and per-vertex fakes lost five consecutive iterations; the acceptance gate is that the reflected bridge arch voids are individually countable from the bridge camera.

check.note: A planar-mirror render target of at least 1024x1024 exists; 512 and below is what reads as blocky/stepped, 256 never passes.

port: In the facet’s water module (e.g. src/water.js) tag the water mesh userData.tag = "water", call renderMirror() at the top of update() before the main render every frame, and keep the render target referenced by the water material uniform so renderTargets() can see it. Expensive mirror passes go in a turn of their own after a screenshot confirms the previous turn boots; verify from the bridge/default camera that the arch voids are countable before claiming a fix.

evidence.note: learned over the bridge/water runs, 5 rejections: ≥1024×1024 target, once per frame, horizontal-only sine distortion ≤0.01
4+ consecutive iterations "blocky/stepped, vague vertical smear": true mirrored pass ≥1024, normal-map UV amplitude ≤0.02, one 3-tap vertical blur only
reflection is the single most repeated loss in water facets; older "≥512px across the visible span" superseded by the ≥1024 rule
planar mirror pass ≥1024×1024, not a cubemap or screen-space approximation; name the hero object in the reflection set
resolution and sampling bug, not a material bug: buffer ≥1024 (never ≤256), bilinear, vertical stretch 1.0–1.3×
